name: Platform 1.5.7
body:
Supply the signed Tenants.Server 7.0.5 body for the existing private SDK 4.1.0 package-test cohort and bind the current-owner Memories container to its actual Dapr HTTP endpoint.

The production-closure regression builds Composition independently of the test project and verifies the genuine Server DLL, runtime asset and isolated model-directory loading. The container regression renders the authenticated current-owner graph through the real Toolkit lifecycle, checking the shared endpoint provider and container-network translation. Historical public selectors and all 349 legacy controls remain unchanged; Builds remains the genuine signed 4.44.11 family.

Exact-source validation: [315 current and 349 same-code legacy cases](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Platform/actions/runs/42281947755), with zero skips, and [all five catalog SDK rows](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Platform/actions/runs/42281947817).

This source release does not grant downstream native or public-consumer acceptance; those retain their own actual execution and cleanup gates.
